# Version 4.157.0
> **Engine and GPU reliability** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 updates to Skia m157 with path, text and GPU correctness improvements. The collected changes also make LibraryImport calling conventions explicit and improve displacement-filter precision. Core managed APIs remain unchanged; the Graphite Metal runtime floor requires attention on Apple mobile targets.

## Breaking Changes

- **Require iOS or tvOS 15 for Graphite Metal** — Graphite Metal adopts an iOS/tvOS 15 runtime minimum; macOS remains at 12. Raise deployment targets when using this backend, and keep any higher managed or application-framework requirement rather than treating the backend floor as the overall platform minimum. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Skia m157** — Moves the bundled renderer to milestone 157 without changing the managed binding surface. HarfBuzzSharp's 14.4.0.200 package revision continues to bundle native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **Path and glyph rendering** — Corrects clipped convex-path rasterization, software coverage-mask bounds, serialized glyph replay and reflected hairline caps. Ganesh rounds text-atlas indices before sampler selection and corrects transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle geometry, including overlapping corner radii. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Graphite clipping and readback** — Corrects clip-key packing, wedge bounds and alpha-to-RGBx GPU readback stride. Clip recording counts effective undrawn elements and warns and skips draws that cannot fit a fresh pass; empty Ganesh flushes no longer leave stale atlas work. ([#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Vulkan cleanup and displacement filters** — Adds a targeted 1 ms device-loss cleanup delay for ARM proprietary Vulkan driver versions 42 through below 56. Native synchronous submission now incorporates fence-wait failure without changing void GRContext.Submit. Float-precision displacement offsets match filter bounds. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Explicit cdecl imports** — Generated LibraryImport declarations now specify CallConvCdecl, matching existing DllImport and callback conventions across SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp, Resources, SceneGraph and Skottie. This corrects the ABI selection that can differ on Windows x86 without changing public signatures. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. Its generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly select cdecl without changing the public API.

## Release Candidate 1 (November 9, 2026)

Corrects reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection, with a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM Vulkan drivers. Managed APIs are unchanged.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1...v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Introduces Skia m157 with rasterization, glyph-replay and Graphite readback fixes, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport metadata. Graphite Metal requires iOS or tvOS 15, subject to higher framework minimums.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.1...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
